style: Painted, soft-shaded cartoon Halloween style matching Archie and Holly; rich but slightly muted colours, warm candlelight and cool moonlight; light from the upper left; transparent background (PNG with alpha), no drop shadow on the floor (the game adds one), no text.
how_to_add: Save a transparent PNG as assets/art/<name>.png. Any size: it is cropped to its opaque area and scaled (furniture to the footprint width, enemies to the target height, wall art to the exact target box). Run the game; real art replaces the placeholder automatically.
